Welcome to [RELAPSE] Are You Malayali? 🌿✨
A high-end digital sanctuary crafted exclusively for the community. Escape the noise, step into the mist, and experience a piece of home right here on Roblox.
Whether you want to explore the foggy forests, chill by the campfire, or just catch up with friends, this is your space.
✨ GAME FEATURES:
🎵 200+ Mallu Songs — A massive in-game soundboard featuring your favorite tracks.
🍃 Cinematic Nature — High-end graphics, realistic lighting, and deeply atmospheric environments.
📱 Max Optimization — Built from the ground up to run perfectly smooth on all devices (Mobile, PC, and Console).
🤝 Chill & Hangout — Beautifully designed spaces (Classroom, Library, Waterfalls) to meet new friends and vibe.
